nativeZh: [医] 钙(20号元素); 阴极, 负极

senses.en: a white metallic element that burns with a brilliant light; the fifth most abundant element in the earth's crust; an important component of most plants and animals
senses.zh: 白色金属元素,用闪亮的光线燃烧; 地壳中第五大丰富的元素; 大部分植物和动物的重要组成部分。

senses.en: a state in the western United States on the Pacific; the 3rd largest state; known for earthquakes
senses.zh: 美国西部濒临太平洋的一个州，面积居全国第三，以地震闻名。
